overview_description.description: Hey Telo develops a voice AI telephone assistant for trades and building services businesses. The platform answers incoming calls via call forwarding and handles routine scenarios such as fault reports, maintenance requests, and general customer inquiries. It filters spam, coordinates emergency call handling, and forwards urgent cases to responsible staff. During active periods, breaks, or after-hours, the assistant captures caller details including names, issues, billing information, and callback numbers. Hey Telo structures this information and passes it into connected trade and business software systems used by home services and building technology firms. The service is intended for contractors, HVAC and home technology providers who want to maintain phone availability while reducing manual administrative work.
